Chapter 07 of 19

The Repair People

East Van / citywide110 BPM
The story

Painters, graffiti writers, sticker makers, paste-up crews, photographers, muralists, anyone with a ladder, a bucket, a marker or a camera and work clothes: these are the Repair People, and they look human enough to disappear into Vancouver.

What the city sees as a tag, a sticker, a mural or a fresh coat of paint is structural maintenance in Terminal City. A Repair Person treats a crack in a wall with the seriousness of a plumber treating a burst pipe. They are hard to get to know. Ask one a question and you will get a short answer and a person already turning back to the work. Nobody knows exactly what they are, and the city has decided not to ask.

They take their priorities from the Morning Meeting and their odd ideas from the Green Static. Everything they fix stays visible, because that is the point: the repair is also the art, and the art is what keeps people noticing. Every repair remains visible. Never leave a crack unmarked.

Terminal City is an original fictional mythology inspired by Vancouver’s geography, weather, wildlife, infrastructure, art, and electronic music. It makes no claim to historical, Indigenous, or religious tradition. Real places are used as settings; the operating system layered on them is invented. Photograph reality. Alter the evidence. Never illustrate the whole myth.
